answer: Epoch-keyed operator ledger: bind each identity to an operator account that posts a per-epoch deposit, where any verified sybil cluster forfeits the operator's entire deposit across all its identities, not just the offending wallet. Enforcement runs whenever a zephyr of correlated signups shares operator payout keys. The attacker's cost scales with total identities per operator, since one detection wipes the whole grove at once. Audit trails through a prism of cross-epoch payout graphs make operator consolidation expensive to hide.
